description: Talk to an existing agent or assign it work using its normal tools, memory, permissions and team. Omit conversation_id to start a new owner conversation; supply it to continue one. Returns acceptance and a durable task_id immediately, NOT a completed answer. Poll get_agent_task and read get_agent_conversation for the actual response. Work continues after MCP disconnects. A follow-up in a busy conversation uses the normal queue. Customer conversations are readable but cannot be impersonated by this tool.

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID returned by these tools.
